fee_notes: The standard Initial Franchise Fee is $25,000. For a Restaurant developed pursuant to a Development Agreement, the balance is reduced to $15,000 (with a $10,000 Development Fee credited against the $25,000 fee). If purchasing an existing company-operated Hardee's Restaurant, the Initial Franchise Fee is included in the purchase price. HR may, in its sole discretion, waive some or all of the Initial Franchise Fee under certain incentive circumstances (e.g., taking over a closed restaurant). In 2025, HR waived the fee in certain instances where a new franchisee was taking over a closed or at-risk Franchised Restaurant.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee is $25,000, although the balance of the Initial Franchise Fee is reduced to $15,000 for a Restaurant developed pursuant to the terms of a Development Agreement. You must pay HR the Initial Franchise Fee, less any Development Fee already paid, when you execute the Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise Fee is fully earned by HR when paid, and it is not refundable.
